overview: A one-page Department of State list-of-papers sheet for the 1938 file on relief for seamen in Japan. It records an October 15 item associated with Yokohama and Johnson concerning the treatment of sick and disabled seamen by foreign governments, and points to the related classification “196.7 Medical Relief/30.”

people.name: Johnson
people.role: Role not stated; associated with the indexed Yokohama paper

subfiles.title: List of papers on relief for seamen in Japan
subfiles.about: An index sheet identifies an October 15 Yokohama paper concerning foreign-government treatment of sick and disabled seamen.
subfiles.summary: The sheet catalogs a paper filed under seamen’s relief in Japan for 1938. The entry names Yokohama and Johnson and gives the date October 15, although the precise meaning of the adjacent numbers “20” and “4438” is unclear from the OCR. A note describes the subject as information on the treatment accorded sick and disabled seamen by foreign governments and cites the related medical-relief classification 196.7 Medical Relief/30.

interest: Although only an administrative index sheet survives here, it is useful evidence of how the State Department classified and cross-referenced information about medical assistance for merchant seamen abroad. It also identifies a potentially relevant October 15 Yokohama document associated with Johnson, enabling a historian to pursue the underlying paper through its date, numbers, and medical-relief cross-reference.
